title: A Hotchpotch for the Biometrician
text:
Hello!
This handbook is a hotchpotch of things that might be useful for the biometrician.
It is acting as a primary dumping ground for things that might be useful but don’t have a clear home to go to.

title: 1  Publishing R package with asreml dependency
text:
Since asreml is a propreity software, you cannot just import asreml in an R package that depends on it.
In the DESCRIPTION file, you ought to add that
SystemRequirements:
    asreml (>= 4.2.0)
Some R packages on CRAN that has an asreml R dependency:

agriutilities
asremlPlus
ASRgenomics
biometryassist
heritable
mintyr
nadiv
statgenGxE
statgenHTP
statgenSTA
wgaim
